situation: A business with a register of supplier contracts that renew automatically.
complication: Several contracts will renew on their old terms unless someone acts in time.
key_question: Which automatic renewals need action before their notice windows close?

work.title: Notice of non-renewal (template)
work.for: A supplier, letter for counsel to review and sign
body: We refer to our agreement with you, which renews automatically unless notice is given.
This letter gives notice that we do not wish the agreement to renew at the end of its current term.
Please confirm receipt of this notice in writing.
Yours faithfully, for and on behalf of the company.
